sourceText:
Oatmeal Banana Bars
By: Karlyn Oyama
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:47pm

Ingredients




3/4 cup Margarine -- softened
1 Egg white -- whipped
2 Bananas -- mashed
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1/2 cup Peanut butter
1 cup Brown sugar -- packed
1/2 teaspoon Salt
4 cups Rolled oats

Preparation

1 Preheat oven at 350. Prepare a 13 x 9 x 2" pan with cooking spray and flour. In a mixing bowl, combine margarine egg white, bananas, vanilla and peanut butter. In another mixing bowl, combine sugar, salt, and oats. Mix wet ingredients with dry ingredients just until moistened. Spread mixture in prepared pan. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool slightly, then cut into bars of about 1 x 2 inches.
